name: Jessica ighoraye
missingPieces: Task 10 relies on unrelated artefacts; capstone Artefact 04 was not solved correctly.
feedback: Your Task 3 answer is strong because it correctly names Artefact A as Vigenere without inventing a plaintext, and it recovers the Base64 and hex messages accurately. Task 7 is also complete, with the empty signature segment, RFC 7519 Section 6.1, CVE-2015-9235, and the correct comparison between alg none and role-claim trust. Task 6 is mostly correct, though it needed sharper next-most-likely comparisons and more precise sectioned citations for full credit. Task 10 answers the board themes in general, but it relies on several unrelated artefacts and does not center the expected AES key and IV evidence cleanly enough. The capstone recovers the main AES, ROT13, JWT, and layered memo evidence, but Artefact 04 stops at saying the secret could not be found instead of proving the token was tampered, recovering the leaked source secret, and forging the valid amaka.eze token.
